article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 40% of TB patients remain undetected; the health sector is promoting universal population screening.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam marked the 117th birthday of Dr. Pham Ngoc Thach as the National TB Control Program and the National Lung Hospital reviewed 2025 achievements and unveiled 2026 plans. In 2025, TB case detection at the National Lung Hospital reached a record, with more than 119,000 cases identified nationwide—the highest in history. Despite gains, late diagnosis remains a major challenge, with an estimated 184,000 new TB cases in 2024 and 12,000 TB deaths; 9,400 cases of multidrug-resistant TB were reported. Treatment success and completion hovered at 90%. To reach the End TB target by 2030, the plan emphasizes screening for TB linked to annual health examinations for every citizen, and recommends rapid, coordinated action across local health systems, advocacy for stronger TB services at provincial lung and TB hospitals, and enhanced training and digital tools. The strategy calls for intensified multi-sectoral engagement and evaluation in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 結核患者の約40%が未検出、保健部門は全国民的なスクリーニングを推進
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの結核制御プログラムに関する公式なキャンペーンであり、検出率向上と全国スクリーニングの推進を示している。既知の感染症対応の計画段階であり、新規のシグナルとしては判定されない。ただし、12,000人の死亡と多剤耐性結核9,400例の報告があり、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 既存の結核対策に関する国家レベルの取り組みの発表であり、新規のアウトブレイク事象ではない。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響）、WPROスクリーニング基準は3つ該当するが、記事は既知疾患への対応計画の進捗報告であるため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: สธ.เฝ้าระวัง ฝีดาษลิง หลังช่วงเทศกาลปี 69 ไทยพบป่วยแล้ว 48 คน ส่วนใหญ่เป็นเพศชาย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MoPH monitors monkeypox after the 2569 BE festival season; Thailand has reported 48 cases, most of them male.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) in Thailand: As of 3 May 2026, 48 confirmed mpox cases for 2026, including 43 Clade II and 5 Clade Ib. Most patients are male, aged 18–39, with transmission mainly via sexual contact; exposure linked to travel and crowded festival events. Incubation 5–21 days; symptoms include fever, fatigue, malaise, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions. The Department of Disease Control notes the situation remains controllable but requires ongoing vigilance and contact tracing, acknowledging that some exposures may be missed. Public health guidance stresses self-observation, hygiene, and avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals, especially after attending events or travel. Authorities continue public awareness campaigns, condom promotion to reduce sexually transmitted infections, and readiness of surveillance and care systems; a helpline is available at 1422.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生省がサルポックスを監視 2569年祭のシーズン後、タイで患者数48人に到達、大多数が男性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。Mpox Clade Iの国際的な関心が高く、タイでの集団発生状況は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: タイでのMpox Clade IおよびClade IIの集団発生。2026年の祭シーズン後に48例の確定患者（Clade II 43例、Clade Ib 5例）が報告されている。性的接触を通じた伝播が主で、18-39歳の男性が大部分。旅行および混雑した祭イベントが暴露源となっており、継続的な接触者追跡と監視体制の維持が必要とされている。Clade Iの拡大に関する国際的な関心があり、フル評価（RRA）対象。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Tak Mudah Jadi Pandemi seperti Covid-19, Ini Penjelasan Epidemiolog
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Isn’t Likely to Become a Pandemic Like COVID-19, Here’s an Epidemiologist’s Explanation.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus cases aboard a cruise ship crossing Argentinian waters in early May 2026 have sparked concern, yet Griffith University epidemiologist Dr. Dicky Budiman says a COVID-19–like pandemic is unlikely. Transmission mainly occurs from environments contaminated with rodent urine, saliva, or droppings that become aerosolized; human-to-human spread is rare, though some strains have shown limited interhuman transmission. Hantavirus can cause Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS), a severe respiratory illness. The virus was first identified in 1976 in Korea (named after the Hantan River), with the 1993 Four Corners, USA outbreak (Sin Nombre) attracting global attention due to high mortality. Fatalities in severe HPS cases can reach about 40%, especially with delayed diagnosis or limited intensive care. In Indonesia, overall risk remains low but is heightened by high rodent populations, seasonal floods, urban sanitation, and dense ports/warehouses. At-risk groups include sanitation, warehouse, port workers, and farmers; prevention emphasizes rodent control, rodent-proof housing, proper food storage, and protective gear when cleaning potentially contaminated areas.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスはCOVID-19のようなパンデミックになりやすくない、疫学者の説明
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスの海上での発生事例は注目されているが、疫学者により「パンデミックの可能性は低い」と評価されている。記事は啓発的性質が強く、即座のリスク上昇を示唆していない。対象国（インドネシア）での背景リスク情報のみ。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月にアルゼンチン領海のクルーズ船でのハンタウイルス発生を報道しているが、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれていない。サマリーにおいてインドネシアでの背景リスク評価（げっ歯類の多さ、洪水、衛生状況）が記載されており、対象国はインドネシアのみ。疫学者による「パンデミックは起こりにくい」という評価があり、即座のエスカレーションリスクは低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Обитающие в России клещи могут переносить вирусы Бейджи и Мукава
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ticks living in Russia can transmit Beiji and Machupo viruses.
article.articleSummary: Ticks in Russia's Northwestern region carry Beiji nairovirus and Machupo virus, according to Rospotrebnadzor via RNA sequencing at Saint Petersburg Pasteur Institute. Viruses previously detected only in human sera from infections in China and Japan were identified in local ticks. A Forest virus with unclear taxonomy, showing similarity to Junin virus, was also found; Russian isolates are not identical to Asian counterparts, and the agent has not been cultured, with its pathogenic properties not yet studied. Researchers warn that viral genomes remain highly variable, with mutations potentially increasing virulence or reducing viability; no definitive assessment of human risk can be made yet. Ongoing surveillance is urged. Practical advice includes wearing protective clothing outdoors, regular self-checks, and routine acaricide treatments in urban green spaces. Earlier assessments had estimated tick-bite risk in Russia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアに生息するマダニはベイジ・ウイルスとマクポ・ウイルスを媒介する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 複数の新興ウイルス（CCHF関連ナイロウイルス、マクポウイルス）がロシアのマダニから検出された異常な発見であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」と「長期曝露」に該当するが、人間への感染リスク評価が確定していないため、追加情報を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な舞台はロシア（対象国リストに含まれない）であるが、ウイルスがかつて中国と日本の人間感染で検出されたと記述されている。IHR基準で2つ該当し、WPROで3つ該当するが、「人間への実際のリスク評価ができない」という重要な制限がある。人間への実感染例はまだ報告されておらず、マダニからの検出のみ。継続的な監視と人間感染例の報告を待つべき段階。対象国検証では、中国は対象国であり記事で言及されているため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: В Роспотребнадзоре рассказали, какие вирусы могут переносить клещи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor explained which viruses can be carried by ticks.
article.articleSummary: Ticks in Northwest Russia carry not only the tick-borne encephalitis virus but also Beiji nairovirus and Mukawa virus, previously detected in human sera in China and Japan. A Forest virus (Leshnoe) was also found in local ticks, though it has no clear taxonomic placement and resembles Nuomin virus strains described in literature. Russian tick-borne viruses do not match Asian strains, and their human pathogenicity remains unestablished pending further research. Genome mutations in tick-borne viruses occur, sometimes reducing viability, other times potentially offering adaptation advantages. Authorities urge ongoing research, noting that viruses cannot be fully eradicated as part of the natural ecosystem. Preventive guidance includes wearing protective clothing and regular tick checks when in forests; urban areas employ acaricidal treatments to reduce tick populations. Vaccination against tick-borne encephalitis remains a key protective measure.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健監視庁が説明：ダニが運搬できるウイルス
triage.triage_reason: ダニ媒介性脳炎とクリミア・コンゴ出血熱に関する情報記事だが、新規感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、既知ウイルスの疫学的知見の共有であり、具体的な患者数や急速な拡大の報告がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は公開情報の啓発・教育的な性質が強く、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。中国・日本でのウイルス検出は過去の検出記録であり、現在の流行拡大を示唆していない。対象国はサマリーに明示されている中国のみ該当。ロシアはMONITOR対象国外であるため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 已致3人死亡，大西洋邮轮上的汉坦病毒到底有多危险？这些知识必须知道｜健康UP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus on an Atlantic cruise ship has already claimed three lives — just how dangerous is it? These are the must-know facts | Health UP
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak aboard the polar expedition cruise ship Hondius, which left Argentina and crossed the South Atlantic, has infected 8 people and caused 3 deaths as of publication. The World Health Organization says the likely culprit is Andes virus, a hantavirus native to South America, with some degree of human-to-human transmission possible. The vessel is currently sailing toward the Canary Islands, Spain. The Chinese embassy in Cape Verde has confirmed there are no Chinese citizens among those affected. The incident raises questions about hantavirus: its nature, transmission, and prevention. The event highlights health risks on international maritime travel and the need for ongoing public health monitoring as investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: 大西洋の邮轮上のハンタウイルスはすでに3人の死亡を招いている — 一体どのくらい危険なのか？これらは知らなければならない知識だ｜健康UP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準で4項目該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。国際的な海上移動を伴う集団発生で、複数国に影響を及ぼす可能性があり、死亡例を含む重症事例がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはアルゼンチン、カーボベルデ、スペインも含まれるが、これらは対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし中国（関連国の大使館が確認）は対象国であり含める。ハンタウイルス（Andes virus）による海上での集団発生で、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があると指摘されており、国際海運における感染症リスク管理の観点からも重要。

article.articleHeadline: 孟加拉国麻疹疫情爆发，已致数百名儿童死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh has killed hundreds of children.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh has killed hundreds of children, with over 32,000 suspected cases and more than 250 deaths. The surge has overwhelmed hospitals, and more than 21,000 children have been hospitalized across 58 of the country’s 64 districts. The outbreak began near Rohingya refugee camps on the Myanmar border in January and threatens spread to Myanmar and India. It stems from a collapse of the vaccine procurement system after the 2024 revolution, causing nationwide vaccine shortages and a sharp drop in routine immunization. In 2025, only about 59% of eligible children received the measles vaccine. Emergency vaccination campaigns started April 5 for ages 6 months–5 years and were expanded nationwide by April 20; vitamin A distribution will resume. Bangladesh’s malnutrition burden (roughly 28% stunting, 10% wasting) worsens disease severity. Officials urge a public health emergency declaration to accelerate action; WHO warns of ongoing transmission and cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュの麻疹流行により数百人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響：250人以上の死亡と32,000人以上の疑似患者、異常性：予防接種制度の崩壊による流行、国際拡大リスク：ミャンマーとインドへの越境拡大の脅威）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目で該当し、WHO警告による国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: バングラデシュ自体は対象国リストに含まれないが、サマリーに明記されたミャンマーとインドへの越境拡大脅威により、この両国を verified_locations に含める。2024年革命後の予防接種システム崩壊が根本原因であり、栄養不良が重症化を悪化させている点も注視。WHO警告あり、公開的健康緊急事態宣言の要求がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Lakukan Pengawasan dan Cegah Masuknya Hantavirus ke RI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Conducts Surveillance and Prevents the Entry of Hantavirus into Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus is the focus of Indonesia’s preventive measures, after an outbreak concentrated on the luxury cruise MV Hondius, currently at sea in the Atlantic. The ship, en route from Ushuaia, Argentina to Cape Verde, reported illnesses among crew and passengers; WHO data up to May 5, 2026, counted 7 sick of 147 people and 3 deaths. Indonesian Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin said Kemenkes is coordinating with WHO to develop hantavirus screening guidelines, considering rapid tests or PCR-based reagents. Indonesia’s widespread PCR capacity may facilitate detection, but reagents must be specific to hantavirus. The government is prioritizing surveillance to detect any spread beyond the vessel and prevent entry of cases into the country. No evidence of domestic transmission is reported, and the focus remains on preventing export/import of cases as the ship continues its voyage.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省はハンタウイルスの監視を実施し、インドネシアへの侵入を防止
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症は国際的な懸念事項であり、インドネシアでは予防監視が開始されている。しかし、インドネシア国内での発生報告はなく、現在のところ高級クルーズ船での限定的な集団発生であるため、情報が不足している段階では WATCH 判定とする。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはアルゼンチン、米国、カーボベルデ、インドネシアが含まれている。しかし記事サマリーの主題を詳細に検証すると、クルーズ船MV Hondiusはアルゼンチンのウシュアイアからカーボベルデへ航行中であり、現在の患者はこの船上に限定されている。インドネシアは予防監視と防止措置を実施しているが、国内での発生報告はなく、イベントの主要な発生地はアルゼンチン・米国・カーボベルデである。対象国リストではインドネシアのみが該当するため、verified_locations にはインドネシアを含める。ただし、実際の感染事例の発生地はいずれも対象国外であり、インドネシアは防疫対応国としての位置付けである点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Este virus sudamericano preocupa más a la OMS que el hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This South American virus worries the WHO more than the hantavirus.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever dominates concerns in South America over hantavirus, per OPS/WHO data for 2024–2025. In 2024, 61 cases and 30 deaths; 2025 soared to over 340 confirmed cases and about 140 deaths across Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Bolivia, Ecuador, Guyana, and Venezuela, marking a fivefold rise. Yellow fever is vector-borne by mosquitoes and risks reurbanization as the virus approaches densely populated areas near Aedes aegypti, raising outbreak potential. By contrast, hantavirus, linked to rodent excreta, remains localized with high lethality but limited spread. In Argentina, 2025–2026 saw around 100 hantavirus cases with ~30 deaths; Chile reports dozens annually. Monkeys in Brazil act as early sentinels with hundreds of primate deaths preceding human outbreaks. A key difference: yellow fever has an effective vaccine conferring lifelong protection after a single dose for most, while no available hantavirus vaccine or antiviral exists. Climate change, deforestation, and urban expansion amplify transmission risk for yellow fever.

triage.headline_ja: この南米ウイルスはハンタウイルスよりもWHOをより懸念させている
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病は南米で急速に拡大（2024年61例→2025年340例以上、死亡数も140名）し、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への影響の深刻さ」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」の4基準すべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、WHO（国際機関）の懸念表明により社会的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは南米全域の黄熱病流行について述べているが、対象国リスト内に該当するのはBrazilのみ。Peru、Colombia、Ecuador、Venezuela、Bolivia、Guyana、Argentina、Chileは対象国外のため除外。ただしBrazilでの流行拡大は明確に記述されており、ワクチン有効性、ベクター媒介性、都市化リスク、気候変動による増幅要因など複合的なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: 汉坦病毒邮轮毒株确认人传人！有无疫苗特效药？会传到中国吗？一文了解
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Cruise-Ship Strain Confirmed for Human-to-Human Transmission! Are Vaccines or Antiviral Drugs Available? Will It Spread to China? Everything You Need to Know in One Article.
article.articleSummary: An Atlantic polar-expedition cruise experienced a hantavirus outbreak. As of May 6, 2026, eight infections are linked to the ship, with three laboratory-confirmed cases; Andes hantavirus has been identified, confirmed by South Africa's NICD and Geneva University Hospital. Hantaviruses are enveloped, segmented negative-sense RNA viruses carried mainly by rodents; human infection occurs via inhalation of rodent excreta aerosols, contact with contaminated materials through broken skin or mucosa, or ingestion of contaminated food. Andes virus is the only hantavirus known to transmit between humans, typically among close contacts or healthcare workers. The cruise reported no Chinese nationals on board, per the Chinese embassy in Cape Verde. In China, hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome is vaccine-preventable through the national program; there is no specific antiviral treatment. Prevention emphasizes rodent control, hygiene, and early medical attention; WHO deems global spread risk low.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス客船株での人から人への感染が確認！ワクチンや特効薬はあるのか？中国に広がるのか？1つの記事で理解する
triage.triage_reason: 大西洋遠征クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生は異常かつ予想外の事象であり、人から人への感染確認により重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示している。IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでハンタウイルス客船集団発生が報告されており、Andes型ハンタウイルスの人から人への感染確認が述べられている。発生地域リストにはスイス、南アフリカ、カーボベルデ、中国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は大西洋遠征クルーズ船（南アフリカおよびカーボベルデ関連）でのイベントである。ただし、記事見出しで「中国に広がるのか」という中国への影響を問題としており、中国国内の関心が高い。サマリーでは「船に中国国籍者は乗っていない」と明記されているが、中国国民への潜在的リスクについて関心が集中している。中国は対象国リストに含まれているため、verified_locationsに含める。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 3 more poultry farms test positive for bird flu in Maharashtra's Navapur as culling operations reach 2.5 lakh
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza confirmed in Navapur, Maharashtra, with three more poultry farms—Palawala, Sakisma, and Ashraf—testing positive in carcass/tissue samples. NIHSAD in Bhopal confirmed presence. The outbreak was first confirmed on April 30 after unusually high mortality at four farms. Authorities imposed a 1-km culling radius and a 3-km containment zone, focusing on backyard poultry; a six-day operation previously culled 2.47 lakh birds and destroyed 9.26 lakh eggs. With the new positives, officials will cull birds at the new sites and redraw containment zones; results from a fourth farm are pending. Central and state teams monitor neighboring clusters to prevent regional spread, and compensation for affected farm owners is being arranged. On the human front, experts say human-to-human transmission is extremely rare; India has two confirmed human cases so far, with no vaccine or treatment available, prompting calls for calm and evidence-based advisories.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州ナヴァプルで鳥インフルエンザH5N1が3つの養鶏場で確認、殺処分作業が25万羽に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行リスク、管理課題）。H5N1ヒト感染の潜在的リスクと地域の公衆衛生インパクトからフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: H5N1はWHO優先監視対象。インドでの持続的な家禽での流行と複数農場での確認は地域的脅威の拡大を示唆。ヒト感染例が既に2件存在することは懸念される。ワクチンや治療薬が利用できない状況下での対応能力評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện bệnh lao gắn với khám sức khỏe định kỳ cho mỗi người dân
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis detection linked to routine health checkups for every citizen.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's National Tuberculosis Program announced 2025 achievements at a Hanoi ceremony marking Pham Ngoc Thach’s birth, reporting 119,000 TB cases detected nationwide with a 90% cure/completion rate. Despite gains, Vietnam remains high-burden: WHO estimates for 2024 show about 184,000 new TB patients, 9,400 drug-resistant TB cases, and roughly 12,000 TB deaths. For 2026, the program's theme is “Detect TB linked with periodic health examinations for every citizen,” integrating TB screening into free routine health checks per political guidance (Resolution 72). Emphasis on expanding technology-enabled diagnosis and screening, stronger public-private collaboration, and robust epidemiological surveillance with adequate funding. Plan includes fortified TB and pulmonary care capacity at local facilities and sustained resources for detection, diagnosis, and treatment, aligned with national and global efforts to end TB in Vietnam by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: 結核検査は市民全員の定期健診と連携して検出される
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの結核対策プログラムの成果報告であり、異常・予想外な事象ではない。WHOが推定する高負担国の状況報告だが、新しい集団発生や緊急事態の兆候は記事内に見当たらない。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの国家結核対策プログラムの年次成果報告・政策発表である。2025年に119,000例の結核患者が検出され、治癒率90%を達成したとの報告。2026年は「市民全員の定期健診と連携した結核検出」がテーマ。WHOの2024年推定によると、ベトナムは約184,000人の新規患者、9,400人の薬剤耐性患者、約12,000人の死亡例を抱える高負担国とされている。プログラムは2030年までのTB終結を目指している。スクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」は該当するが、急性的な危機的状況ではなく、予定されたプログラム報告のため「WATCH」判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam tightens airport checks to prevent foot-and-mouth disease
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in Vietnam is a focal threat to livestock, prompting the Civil Aviation Authority of Vietnam (CAAV) to tighten airport surveillance nationwide, with emphasis on preventing entry of the SAT1 serotype. All airports must strengthen epidemic prevention and enforce disease-control regulations, while agencies coordinate to curb illegal transport or trade of animals and products lacking origin or quarantine certification. FMD is highly infectious, affecting buffalo, cattle, pigs, goats, and sheep, with seven serotypes: O, A, C, Asia1, SAT1, SAT2, SAT3. In Vietnam, serotypes O, A, and Asia1 circulate (O most prevalent); SAT1, once confined to Africa, is expanding its geographic range. Since March 2025, outbreaks have been reported in Iraq and several Middle East/West Asia countries; in early April 2026, China reported cattle outbreaks in Gansu and Xinjiang. Vietnam has not detected SAT1, but the introduction risk is high, especially via illegal cross-border movement. Vaccines licensed in Vietnam cover O, A, and Asia1, not SAT1, meaning SAT1 introduction could severely impact cattle and buffalo herds.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムが口蹄疫防止のための空港検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）の地域的拡大（中国、イラク、中東での最近の発生）と、ベトナムへの侵入リスクが高まっており、IHR基準3項目該当。動物への深刻な影響と国際的な拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイラク（対象国リストに非対象）やアフリカ大陸での発生にも言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれる国は中国とベトナムのみ。中国での最近の発生（2026年4月、甘粛・新疆）とベトナムへの侵入リスク増大が主要な焦点。SAT1血清型の未検出だが高い侵入リスクと、既存ワクチンのカバー範囲外という課題が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Diarrhea Outbreak Reported Among Residents and Fishermen in Kyaikkhami - IMNA
article.articleSummary: Diarrhea outbreak in Kyaikkhami, Mon State, Myanmar, began April 30 with five fishermen from Aungthukha Ward developing symptoms. The five were admitted to Kyaikkhami Public Hospital; four in serious condition were transferred to Mawlamyine General Hospital for further care. More than 30 family members and local residents from the ward have been quarantined and monitored at Kyaikkhami Public Hospital. A disease prevention team from the State Public Health Department conducted field inspections on May 1, and Thanbyuzayat Township Public Health Department is conducting awareness campaigns and preventive measures. The report describes an ongoing outbreak in Kyaikkhami with diarrhea as the presenting illness; laboratory confirmation is not mentioned. Background context notes that in 2024 around 80 local residents, including fishermen, were infected with diarrhea, with at least six deaths. The infection source and any imported/exported cases are not identified in the article.

triage.headline_ja: Kyaikkhami地域の住民と漁民に下痢の集団発生が報告
triage.triage_reason: 未確定の原因不明疾患（下痢症状）の集団発生がミャンマーで報告されているが、病原体確認、重症度の程度、国際的拡大リスクが不明であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに記載されている地名（Mon State、Kyaikkhami、Mawlamyine）はいずれもミャンマー内の地域であり、Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに含まれるMyanmarを verified_locations として確認。疾患原因が特定されていない（Unknown Illness）ため、病原体特定と検査結果の報告を要注視。2024年の類似事例（6名の死亡者を含む80名感染）が記載されており、反復性の下痢発生パターンが示唆される。国際的拡大リスクは現時点では低いと判定。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: महाराष्ट्र के इस इलाके में फैला बर्ड फ्लू, क्या होता है ये और आपको कितना कर सकता बीमार, लक्षण-खतरे और बचाव सब जानिए
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu (avian influenza) has spread in this area of Maharashtra: What is it and how sick can it make you? Symptoms, risks, and precautions—everything you need to know.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) has re-emerged in Navapur, Nandurbar district, Maharashtra, prompting heightened surveillance and containment measures. The disease primarily affects birds, but human infections can occur, especially among poultry farm workers, doctors, transport staff, and those dealing with infected birds or waste. Viruses such as H5N1 are among the dangerous strains with potential to infect humans. Transmission to people occurs via contact with infected birds, their droppings, feathers, saliva, or contaminated environments; inhalation of contaminated dust or air can also pose a risk. In humans, initial symptoms resemble flu: fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, weakness, shortness of breath; severe cases can lead to pneumonia, lung inflammation, and hypoxia, sometimes requiring ventilation. Early antiviral treatment within 48 hours can help. Fully cooked chicken and eggs are safe; undercooked meat should be avoided. Authorities stress hygiene and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: マハーラシュトラ州のこの地域に鳥インフルエンザが流行、症状・危険性・予防策をすべて知る
triage.triage_reason: インドのマハーラシュトラ州ナーワープルでH5N1鳥インフルエンザが確認された。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある新興感染症であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクの複数該当、WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で該当するため、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのマハーラシュトラ州ナーワープルでのH5N1確認を報じている。ヒト感染リスクのある病原体で、家禽労働者・医療従事者など特定層への職業的曝露がある。初期段階での報告と考えられるが、IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPRO基準5つ全て該当しており、国際的な関心が高い案件。フルRRA実施推奨。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Así fue mi cuarentena junto a los repatriados de Wuhan en el Hospital Gómez Ulla seis años antes del próximo encierro de los españoles del crucero con hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This Is How My Quarantine Went Alongside the Wuhan Repatriates at Gómez Ulla Hospital, Six Years Before the Next Lockdown of the Spaniards from the Hantavirus-Infected Cruise Ship.
article.articleSummary: On January 29, 2020, as Wuhan faced a strict lockdown with 6,070 infections and 132 deaths, 21 Spaniards among 120 aboard PLM8371 were evacuated to Spain via Brize Norton and Torrejón de Ardoz. They quarantined for two weeks at Hospital Gómez Ulla in Carabanchel, on the 17th floor. A first PCR on day four—conducted at Hospital Carlos III—came back negative; medical staff explained that a positive case would send them to the High Isolation Unit on floor 22, a negative-pressure, eight-room capsule setup with four HEPA filters and automated decontamination, monitored by cameras. Families visited in protective suits. Six years later, 14 Spaniards from a hantavirus-infected cruise ship are slated for quarantine at Gómez Ulla; upon arrival in Tenerife they will fly to Torrejón and then to the hospital, with the isolation wing prepared. The article recalls Illa’s February 13, 2020 briefing and debates about cancelling the Mobile World Congress.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性出血熱患者が隔離されたスペイン武漢駐在員の6年前の検疫体験と現在のハンタウイルス感染クルーズ船乗客の隔離予定
triage.triage_reason: スペインでハンタウイルス感染者を含むクルーズ船乗客の隔離予定が報道されているが、記事の大部分は過去の2020年武漢疎開事例の回顧であり、現在のイベントの詳細（患者数、重症度、感染確認の有無など）が不明。スクリーニング基準の充足判定に必要な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年の過去イベント回顧が主軸で、現在のハンタウイルス関連イベント（スペイン在住者が乗船していたクルーズ船）の詳細が限定的。Bluedot APIは中国（武漢、湖北省）も発生地域として抽出しているが、サマリーでは主に2020年のスペイン側イベントが記述されており、現在の中国側での活動については記載なし。したがってverified_locationsはSpainのみ。ハンタウイルスは高リスク病原体であり、クルーズ船での確認は異常・予想外だが、患者数、重症度、感染確認状況などの詳細情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。続報でイベントの詳細が判明すれば判定見直しが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Countries race to track disembarked passengers of hantavirus-hit cruise ship
article.articleSummary: MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak: Off the coast of Cape Verde, three deaths (a Dutch couple and a German national) and eight suspected infections. The World Health Organization reports eight suspected cases, with lab confirmation that the virus is the Andean strain, spread through very close contact and considered rare. The Dutch man died aboard on April 11; his wife, who disembarked earlier in Santa Helena, fell ill and died before reaching the Netherlands; she had been removed from a KLM flight in Johannesburg on April 25 due to deteriorating condition. About 40 passengers disembarked in Santa Helena during a stop en route to Cape Verde before the outbreak was reported; their whereabouts are largely unknown. Countries scramble to trace disembarked passengers to curb spread as the ship remains marooned off Cape Verde. Ongoing response focuses on containment, contact tracing, and lab-confirmed Andean hantavirus.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染が発生したクルーズ船から下船した乗客の追跡に各国が奔走
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で3項目該当（異常・予想外性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国にまたがる死亡事例と疑い患者、実験室確認済みのアンデス型ハンタウイルス、下船乗客の追跡不能による国際的な感染拡大リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際の感染発生地はケープベルデ沖（大西洋）のクルーズ船上およびサンタ・ヘレナ（対象国ではない）、ジョハネスブルグ（南アフリカ、対象国ではない）。ただし、Bluedotが検出した発生地域リストにはブラジル（マラニョン州・サンタ・ヘレナ）が含まれており、これはクルーズ船の乗客下船地点（サンタ・ヘレナ=ブラジル北東部）を示唆している。対象国リスト内では Brazil のみが該当。このイベントは国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Passengers who disembarked hantavirus cruise ship still unaccounted-for
article.articleSummary: MV Hondius, carrying nearly 150 people, is due to dock in Tenerife, Canary Islands, amid an Andean hantavirus outbreak on board. Eight others, including a Swiss citizen, are suspected infected; around 40 passengers disembarked in Santa Helena before the outbreak was reported. The wife of a Dutch man who died on board on April 11 also fell ill and died in Johannesburg after being removed from a plane on April 25. Three evacuated patients include one to the Netherlands, another to Germany, and a third whose Netherlands-bound plane had to divert due to a life-support issue in Gran Canaria. Hantavirus transmission is linked to rodent droppings, urine or saliva; the Andean strain can spread via close contact. The US CDC says overall risk to Americans is extremely low; a French citizen had contact with an ill person but is asymptomatic. Upon docking, non-Spanish passengers will be repatriated; 14 Spanish passengers will be quarantined in Madrid. Argentina’s Ushuaia is investigating a potential source, trapping rodents as 101 hantavirus infections have been reported there since June 2025, linked to climate-change-driven rodent expansion.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染船から下船した乗客がまだ行方不明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常/予想外な集団感染、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）し、複数国での死亡・重症者の発生、国際的な医療対応が実施されている。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リスト内には複数の対象国外地域が含まれているが、記事サマリーに基づき実際の流行地はアルゼンチン（ウスアイア：対象国リスト外）および対象国ブラジル（マラニャン州での報告）。スペイン・南アフリカ・オランダ・ドイツ・フランス・米国は患者の移送先または接触者確認地であり、流行発生地ではない。ただし国際的な海上感染事例として複数国の保健当局が関与しており、公開情報の限定性を勘案すると、対象国ブラジルでの報告記述があるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ministry tightens screening in response to cruise ship's hantavirus
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Health Ministry, coordinating with the WHO, tightens hantavirus screening after a case on a cruise ship, signaling a shift toward rapid testing or PCR-based surveillance while maintaining enhanced surveillance. As of May 4, WHO reported six suspected hantavirus cases linked to a ship in the Atlantic, including three deaths; one patient is in intensive care in South Africa, and two others aboard are to be evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment. About 150 people are on the ship, which is off the coast of Cape Verde. Evacuation arrangements to the Netherlands involve two patients. Separately, Spain's Ministry of Health announced the Canary Islands will receive the cruise ship MV Hondius after a hantavirus outbreak on board, with the WHO and the EU requesting Spain to accept MV Hondius.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船のハンタウイルスに対応して保健省がスクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な健康被害・死亡あり、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での患者発生・死亡事例、国際機関（WHO）が関与する多国間対応で、速やかなフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示唆した発生地域（米国、カナリア諸島、南アフリカ、オランダ、カーボベルデ、スペイン）は記事の主題からは対象国に該当しない。インドネシアは記事冒頭で「インドネシア保健省がWHOと協力してハンタウイルス検査を強化」と明記されており、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ただし、船上での患者・死亡がアフリカ大西洋上（カーボベルデ沖）で発生しているため、実質的な流行中心は対象国外であることに注意。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор рассказал, какие вирусы переносят клещи, помимо энцефалита
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor explained which viruses ticks carry besides encephalitis.
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne pathogens in Russia include not only tick-borne encephalitis but also Beiji nairovirus, Mukawa virus, and Nuomin virus (Forest virus). In Russia’s Northwestern region, scientists have detected these agents in ticks; previously they were identified in human sera in China and Japan. The Russian strains are not identical to Asian ones, and their pathogenicity requires further study. Researchers used RNA sequencing but did not isolate live viruses or characterize their biological properties. The claim that these viruses could threaten humans rests on data from other countries where they were found in people with infection signs. Viral genomes mutate over time, and some mutations may render a virus nonviable. Earlier, Ilya Gomyaranov noted that tick-borne borreliosis has spread across much of Russia (2024: 78 regions). There is a vaccine for tick-borne encephalitis, but not for borreliosis; protection relies on preventing tick bites and prompt tick removal.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナドゾル、ダニが脳炎以外に媒介するウイルスについて説明
triage.triage_reason: ダニ媒介感染症（TBE、CCHF、ライム病）の検出報告だが、記事の主題は既知病原体の疫学情報提供であり、新規の臨床的アウトブレイク、死亡、または急速な拡大は記述されていない。情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事は主にロシア北西部で検出されたダニ媒介病原体について政府当局（ロスポトレブナドゾル）が提供する疫学情報。中国と日本での過去の検出事例に言及されているが、サマリーの主題はロシアの状況であり、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には China のみを含める。TBEとライム病の長期的曝露リスクと流行可能性は確認されるが、新規のアウトブレイク、重症例、または死亡は記述されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Debut cu scandal pentru acordul UE-Mercosur: 80% din puiul brazilian ajuns în Grecia, contaminat cu Salmonella
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Debut marred by scandal for the EU-Mercosur agreement: 80% of Brazilian chicken meat that has arrived in Greece is contaminated with Salmonella.
article.articleSummary: 80% of a three-ton batch of frozen Brazilian chicken meat destined for Greece tested positive for Salmonella at Agia Paraskevi labs, leading to immediate shipment rejection. The incident occurred as provisional application of the EU-Mercosur trade agreement began on May 1, 2026. It exposes concerns about border controls, given zero tolerance for Salmonella in EU poultry, with TRACES-NT and RASFF systems used for risk notification, while physical checks are risk-based and not universal. Greece's veterinary services operate with about 40% of needed staff; no official Greek statement or importer identity released. Brazilian policy allows reentry of export-rejected products after processing, drawing consumer-protection criticisms. The event echoes a 2019 case where 1,400 tonnes of Brazilian chicken were rejected at the UK border; some meat re-entered Brazil. Major Brazilian producers like JBS and BRF are noted. The interim EU-Mercosur deal remains in effect; retroactive withdrawal not possible.

triage.headline_ja: EU・メルコスール協定に汚点：ブラジルから輸入のニワトリ肉80％がギリシャでサルモネラ汚染
triage.triage_reason: 食品汚染イベント（Salmonella）の報告であり、EU食品安全規制に関する国境検査の問題が露呈。ただしパラチフス/チフスとの疾患名登録が不正確と思われ、タイムリーな感染症危機管理リスクとしては情報不足のため経過観察段階。
triage.notes: 記事は食品汚染事案（Salmonella in poultry）の報告。疾患名にParatyphoid/Typhoidが登録されているが、実質はSalmonella汚染であり、感染症アウトブレイクではなく食品安全インシデント。対象国はブラジル産品がギリシャで検出されたため、Brazilのみを verified_locations に含める（ギリシャ・英国は対象外）。IHR基準では異常性と貿易制限リスクが該当。フルRRA前段階としては、ヒト感染症アウトブレイクの確認と実際の患者発生の有無について続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: 涉汉坦病毒疫情邮轮将停靠西班牙海岛 专家：不必过度担心 我国有疫苗储备
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus outbreak-related cruise ship to dock at a Spanish island; experts say there is no need to worry excessively; China has vaccine stockpiles.
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, a World Health Organization official is coordinating to divert the cruise ship Hondius, linked to a hantavirus exposure, to Spain’s Canary Islands for medical care. The Chinese embassy in Cabo Verde said on May 5 that there are no Chinese citizens aboard. The ship has reported one death on board, prompting attention to hantavirus. Hong Kong University professor Jin Dongyan notes hantavirus is not new and historically caused hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome, but it is now well controlled; prompt containment and source tracing can prevent spread, and Chinese residents need not panic. China also maintains hantavirus vaccine stockpiles. Health authorities are monitoring the situation and facilitating medical disposition for those affected.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染症アウトブレイク関連のクルーズ船がスペインの島に寄港予定；専門家は過度な懸念は不要と述べ、中国はワクチン備蓄を保有
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス曝露関連のクルーズ船事案であり、複数国（中国・香港・スペイン・カーボベルデ）に関連するが、死亡者は1名と限定的で、主に国際輸送リスク管理の段階。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際のハンタウイルス地域内伝播は報告されておらず、主な懸念はクルーズ船上の閉鎖環境での曝露と国際的なリスク管理。スペイン・カーボベルデは寄港地・キューバン関連地として言及されているが、実際の疫学的イベント発生地は確認されない。中国は香港経由の関連性と、WHOの国際協調の中心として記事に登場するため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: MV Hondius' 38 Filipino crew don't have hantavirus, DMW says
article.articleSummary: 38 Filipino crew aboard the MV Hondius have not contracted hantavirus, per Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Cacdac and the Department of Health, while monitoring continues. The ship, about 150 aboard, is traveling from Ushuaia, Argentina to Cape Verde and is expected to dock in Tenerife, Canary Islands, by Saturday; non-Spanish passengers will be repatriated and 14 Spanish travelers quarantined in Madrid. Three deaths are reported: a German passenger and a Dutch couple, with WHO suspecting the Dutch pair may have been infected before boarding. A British national remains in intensive care in South Africa; three other Europeans were evacuated for suspected hantavirus, two in critical condition in the Netherlands. South Africa's NICD notes some passengers carried the Andes hantavirus strain, which can spread person-to-person, though WHO says the general population risk is low. The DOH will test exposed individuals and coordinate with WHO.

triage.headline_ja: MV Hondius船の38名のフィリピン人乗務員はハンタウイルスに感染していない、DMWが発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国にまたがる船舶関連の感染症イベントで、既に3名の死亡、複数の重症者がおり、Andes型ハンタウイルスのヒト-ヒト感染可能性が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが多数の国を列挙しているが、記事サマリーの主要な発生・影響地点はスペイン、アルゼンチン、南アフリカ、オランダ、ドイツ、イギリスであり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれていない。ただしフィリピン人乗務員が関与し、フィリピン当局（DMW、DOH）が直接関与しているため、Philippinesをverified_locationsに含める。本イベントは国際海上での疫学的に重要な感染症事例であり、複数国間の調整、WHO関与、死亡・重症者の発生があることからフルRRAが必須。

article.articleHeadline: 荷蘭郵輪爆漢坦病毒疫情　本港衞生防護中心確定船上無香港居民 - RTHK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus outbreak on a Dutch cruise ship; Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection confirms there were no Hong Kong residents on board - RTHK
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak on the Dutch cruise ship Hondius has prompted Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection (CHP) to report that no Hong Kong residents were on board, and Hong Kong has recorded zero hantavirus infections this year as of 7 May 2026. Based on WHO and other authorities, the CHP regards the global risk as low. CHP Director Xu Lok-ken said Port Health has engaged the Airport Authority, tourism bodies, terminal operators and cruise companies to share updates, preventive guidance and health information. In Hong Kong, hantavirus is a notifiable disease; doctors must report suspected or confirmed cases for epidemiological investigations and control. At entry points, border health assesses travellers with illness or fever and refers to hospital if needed. There is no hantavirus vaccine; management is supportive, with early medical care important. The CHP will monitor global hantavirus developments and adjust local measures accordingly.

triage.headline_ja: オランダ客船でハンタウイルス疫情　香港衛生防護中心が船上に香港居民なしと確認
triage.triage_reason: オランダの客船でハンタウイルス集団発生が報告されているが、香港への影響は限定的（船上に香港居民なし、香港での感染ゼロ）。国際的には限定的な広がりで、現在のところWHO及び関係当局が全体リスクを低いと評価している。情報が不足しており、発生船舶の詳細な状況や感染者数、重症度などが明記されていない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIがNetherlands（オランダ）を発生地域として提示しているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事サマリーではオランダの客船での発生が主題だが、香港（China に含める）での対応と確認が報告されている。感染者数、重症度、感染源などの詳細情報が不足している。IHR基準では2項目該当しているが、実際のリスクは現時点で限定的と評価されているため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus explained: How deadly is it and how do you catch it?
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus is a rare, potentially lethal rodent-borne disease highlighted by a cruise ship outbreak on the MV Hondius, which sailed from Ushuaia, Argentina toward the Cape Verde Islands. The World Health Organization has confirmed multiple Hondius cases and at least three deaths, with teams suspecting the Andes strain and possible person-to-person transmission in close quarters. Andes-strain hantavirus causes hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) in the Americas, starting with flu-like symptoms and progressing to shortness of breath as lungs fill with fluid; mortality about 38%. By contrast, European/Asian strains cause hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) with ~10% fatality. Incubation is 1–8 weeks. No specific antiviral is available; treatment is supportive. Prevention centers on rodent exclusion and careful cleansing of droppings (gloves, bleach, five-minute wait). Global HFRS cases are estimated at 60,000–100,000 annually, about half in China.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスの説明：どのくらい危険で、どのようにして感染するのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。cruise ship outbreak により複数国への拡大リスクあり、WHO確認済み死亡例3名以上、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性指摘。
triage.notes: 記事はArgentinaのUshuaiaから出発したクルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生を報道。Spain（Canary Islands）とCabo Verdeは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは主な発生地域として具体的に特定されていない。Chinaは世界的HFRS症例の約半数を占めるとの背景情報として言及されているが、本イベント自体の発生地ではないため除外。対象国リストではArgentina（3469034）のみが該当し、verified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: 疫情暴发，中方连夜发声核实，涉疫船舶转交第三国，谭德塞已行动_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak Erupts as China Issues Overnight Statements to Verify; Epidemic-Related Vessels Handed Over to a Third Country; Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus Has Taken Action
article.articleSummary: An Atlantic cruise ship, the Hondiarius (洪迪厄斯号), suddenly reports a hantavirus outbreak with high mortality. By day three, one confirmed case, five suspected, and three deaths (roughly 50% case fatality). With hundreds aboard, docking is blocked; Cape Verde refused entry to protect public health. The Chinese embassy in Cape Verde quickly issued a notice confirming no Chinese citizens are aboard. To prevent cross-border spread, the ship will be transferred to a third country: Spain’s Canary Islands will receive the vessel and all passengers and crew, conducting staged disembarkation with on-site nucleic acid testing, health screening, and isolation of confirmed/suspected cases. The WHO, led by Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, has activated its global emergency response mechanism and coordinates medical resources and risk assessment; South Africa’s NICD has joined to sequence the virus and trace contacts. The goal is sea-based containment to prevent land transmission and ensure treatment for affected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 疫情暴発、中方連夜發聲核實、涉疫船舶轉交第三國、譚德塞已行動
triage.triage_reason: 大西洋クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発症、50%の症例致命率、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、WHO緊急対応機構の起動により、IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目該当するため。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域（スペイン、南アフリカ、カーボベルデ）はいずれも船舶の寄港地/対応国であり、ハンタウイルス集団発症の実際の発生地ではない。記事サマリーから、イベントの主題は大西洋上のクルーズ船での発症であり、中国大使館が中国国民がいないことを確認している点から、中国との連携対応事例として位置付けられている。対象国リストの中では China のみが verified_locations に該当。高い致命率（50%）、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、WHO緊急対応メカニズムの起動により、フルRRA進行の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hospitalitzada una hostessa de vol que va viatjar amb una pacient amb hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A flight attendant who traveled with a patient with hantavirus has been hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: A suspected first hantavirus case in a non‑Hondius traveler: a Dutch KLM flight attendant from Haarlem is hospitalized in Amsterdam with possible hantavirus after contact with a deceased Dutch patient who had been aboard the Hondius and died from the virus. The deceased was the wife of the outbreak’s first victim, who died aboard on April 11; the airline passenger had briefly been in Johannesburg on April 25 and was not allowed to fly due to health. On the Hondius, three confirmed infections are reported (the ship’s doctor, an assistant, and another crew member). WHO evacuated them to a Cape Verde airport for medevac to the Netherlands; one flight arrived, another paused in the Canary Islands due to a technical issue. In total eight cases (three dead, five hospitalized). Twenty-three passengers who disembarked at Santa Helena on April 23 and returned home are being sought for monitoring; a Zurich, Switzerland passenger fell ill two weeks later. The WHO has 140 aboard under control; the search for the 23 unmonitored travelers continues worldwide (Australia, the United States, the United Kingdom, Taiwan). The Hondius is steering to Granadilla de Abona, Tenerife, where disembarkation will occur only after health checks confirming no hantavirus, with evacuations to Tenerife airport by charter or military flights starting next day.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス患者と搭乗した客室乗務員が入院
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な集団感染事例であり、複数国での患者確認、死亡症例の報告、渡航制限のリスク、国際的な接触者追跡の必要性が認められ、IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には南アフリカ、スペイン（カナリア諸島）、スイス、オランダ、米国、英国、台湾、オーストラリア、カーボベルデが含まれるが、評価対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ（記事サマリーに『Santa Helena』が4月23日に記載されており、これはブラジル・マラニャー州の港湾都市）。クルーズ船『Hondius』上での集団感染であり、複数国での患者確認、死亡症例（3名）、国際的な接触者追跡対象者（23名の未監視乗客）が存在することから、高いリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 38 Filipino crew on MV Hondius free of hantavirus  --  DMW - Manila Standard
article.articleSummary: May 7, 2026 — All 38 Filipino crew members aboard the cruise vessel MV Hondius remain free of hantavirus after the ship was allowed to dock near the Canary Islands. Reported hantavirus infections involve passengers only, with three passenger deaths and at least one hospitalization reported. The crew’s condition is stable, and they are being monitored as authorities assess the health situation with the vessel near or at port in the Canary Islands. The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) is coordinating with international counterparts and the World Health Organization to safeguard overseas Filipino workers on board. Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac emphasizes removing seafarers during health emergencies and adherence to international maritime and health protocols to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: MV Hondius号上のフィリピン人乗組員38名がハンタウイルス陰性 - 海外労働者庁
triage.triage_reason: 国際航海船舶における複数死亡例を伴うハンタウイルス集団発生であり、IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準での重症度と流行しやすさが認められる。船舶という特殊環境での感染管理と国際的な監視体制が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、イベントの主舞台はカナリア諸島（スペイン）近くの国際航海船舶MV Hondiusである。フィリピン人乗組員38名が搭乗しており、フィリピア人の安全と帰国に関する関心がフィリピン海外労働者庁により報告されている。死亡者は乗客（乗組員以外）に限定されているが、複数死亡が確認されている。船舶の国際的な寄港地がカナリア諸島（スペイン領）であるため、スペイン・カナリア諸島も発生地域として機能しているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めない。主な関心事はフィリピン国籍の労働者の安全であり、フィリピンのみを検証済み拠点として計上。

article.articleHeadline: Countries scramble to track passengers of virus-hit cruise ship - BusinessWorld Online
article.articleSummary: On 7 May 2026, tracing intensified after hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius, marooned off Cape Verde following a stop in Santa Helena, as the ship heads to Tenerife, Spain. Three deaths are confirmed (two Dutch, one German); eight others, including a Swiss citizen, are suspected to have contracted Andean hantavirus, which spreads by very close contact and is considered rare. About 40 passengers disembarked in Santa Helena before the outbreak was detected. A Dutch wife of a deceased passenger died in the Netherlands; a KLM stewardess with contact to her is hospitalized in Amsterdam; another Dutch woman is admitted for testing. The US CDC monitors travelers; risk to Americans is deemed extremely low. In Spain, non-Spanish passengers will be repatriated; 14 Spanish passengers will be quarantined in Madrid. Three evacuated patients: one in the Netherlands, one in Germany, and another in the Netherlands due to a life-support delay. Argentina will trap rodents in Ushuaia, the voyage origin.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス感染したクルーズ船の乗客追跡に各国躍起 - BusinessWorld Online
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡3名・疑い患者8名、国際的拡大リスク：複数国での患者確認、渡航制限リスク：乗客の隔離・追跡・移送）。稀な病原体による複数国間での多発症例であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: クルーズ船のルート上に複数国が関与（オランダ、スペイン、ドイツ、スイス、アルゼンチン、カーボベルデ等）。Bluedotが付与した発生地域の多くはクルーズ船の寄港地・患者転院先。実際の感染イベント発生地域はMV Hondius船上および関連国。対象国リストでは、船の起点がアルゼンチン（ウスアイア）、転院先にブラジルの地名（マラニャン州、サンタ・エレーナ）が含まれるが、サマリーの主題はクルーズ船での国際的アウトブレイク。ブラジルは検証対象地域として含める（ウスアイア出発点の関連で）。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo bệnh truyền nhiễm nguy hiểm mùa hè 2026 ảnh hưởng sức khỏe cộng đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning About Dangerous Infectious Diseases in Summer 2026 Affecting Public Health
article.articleSummary: Summer 2026 poses heightened infectious disease risks, per WHO and Gavi. The 2025–2026 influenza season shows a complex pattern with at least 15 million cases, 180,000 hospitalizations, and over 7,400 deaths; child vaccine uptake has fallen below 50%, raising concerns that altered vaccination guidance could weaken herd immunity. Avian influenza viruses continue circulating in animals with sporadic spillovers; though human transmission remains low, H5N1’s high virulence sustains vigilance for possible mutations. Measles is re-emerging: US recorded more than 2,000 cases in 2025; Canada has lost measles elimination status, and Singapore enforced mandatory isolation and contact tracing in 2026. UNICEF warns millions of children lack full measles vaccination. Marburg virus disease threatens parts of Africa (Guinea, Ghana, Tanzania, Equatorial Guinea, Rwanda, Ethiopia) with case fatality over 50% and bat reservoirs. Disease X remains a looming pandemic warning; conflict, displacement, climate change, funding cuts, and misinformation amplify risks, including cholera and dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年夏の危険な感染症に関する警告 地域保健に影響
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹、マールブルグウイルス病、鳥インフルエンザなど複数の重篤な感染症が複数国で報告または拡大のリスクが示唆されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはWHO・Gaviの警告に基づく総括的レポート。マールブルグ病はアフリカ6カ国（ギニア、ガーナ、タンザニア、赤道ギニア、ルワンダ、エチオピア）での発生を明記。麻疹は米国・カナダ・シンガポールでの再興を報告。H5N1鳥インフルエンザは動物循環と人への散発的スピルオーバーが続行中。対象国ではガーナは確実に含める。ザンビアは直接言及されていないため判断留保するが、「アフリカ全域」の記述とマールブルグ病の地理的脅威から含める可能性あり。ベトナムのソース（AF Family）は地域保健警告の翻訳記事と推定。

article.articleHeadline: Another woman dies of infection after C-section at Kota govt hospital, 4 others remain critical
article.articleSummary: Kota, May 7: After caesarean deliveries at New Medical College Hospital (NMCH), Kota, at least six women developed post-operative infections on Monday evening. Payal (26) died Tuesday morning; Jyoti Nayak (19) died Thursday morning, after being ventilated. Four other infected women remain critical with severe kidney failure, and are being prepared for transfer to a higher centre in Jaipur. The newborn, as well as the four other infants, are under medical observation in the NICCU and are in sound health. A medical team from Sawai Man Singh Medical College, Jaipur, arrived to assist. Family protests; allegations of wrong dosing were raised by Jyoti's husband. Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla visited; Kota district administration has formed committees to probe the matter; reports are awaited.

triage.headline_ja: コタ政府病院のC-section後の感染で女性が死亡、4人が重篤状態
triage.triage_reason: 医療関連感染による死亡・重症例の集団発生、院内感染管理の失敗の可能性、公式調査開始、高い社会政治的関心。IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 医療関連感染（Healthcare-Associated Infection: HAI）による集団発生事例。原因病原体は未特定（Unknown Illness）。母体死亡2例、腎機能障害による重症例4例。同一医療施設内での多数例発生、医療ミスの可能性、および家族による抗議活動が記載。高位レベル（Lok Sabha Speaker）の関心と複数の公式調査委員会の設置が確認された。院内感染管理システムの失敗を示唆する事例として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 邮轮暴发疫情！汉坦病毒人传人？我们要注意啥？看疾控专家来解读2026年4月，一艘名为“洪迪厄斯”号的极地探险邮轮报告了8例汉坦病毒感染病例，其中3人不幸丧生。汉坦病毒是一种由老鼠传播的病毒，主要通过吸入污染尘埃或接触污染食物等途径感染。此次疫情中，病毒可能在一定范围内通过密切接触传播。汉坦病毒感染早期症状易被误判为普通感冒，但会迅速恶化。预防措施包括灭鼠、保持环境整洁和个人防护。世卫组织表示公众风险较低，无需恐慌。
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cruise outbreak! Is hantavirus human-to-human transmission? What should we watch for? CDC experts explain in April 2026: A polar expedition cruise ship named 'Hondius' reported 8 hantavirus infections, three of which died.
article.articleSummary: Hondius, a polar expedition cruise ship departing Ushuaia, Argentina, has reported 8 hantavirus infections among about 150 passengers and crew as of May 6, 2026, with 3 deaths. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne RNA viruses; human infection typically results from inhaling dust contaminated with rodent urine, feces, or saliva, or from contact with contaminated food. Andes virus is the notable human-to-human transmission exception, and WHO experts suggest some close-contact transmission may have occurred on the ship. Early symptoms mimic flu, then progress to hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (kidney injury) or hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (lung failure). Incubation is 1–8 weeks. Prevention centers on rodent control and avoiding contaminated environments; PPE and proper disinfection are essential. China has an inactivated vaccine for HFRS (>90% protection). Other rodent-borne diseases include plague, leptospirosis, scrub typhus, and murine typhus. WHO says overall risk is low; no travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: 邮轮暴发疫情！汉坦病毒人传人？我们要注意啥？看疾控专家来解读（クルーズ船で疫病発生！ハンタウイルスのヒト-ヒト感染？何に注意すべきか？疾病管理専門家の解説を参照）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。複数国を航海する極地探検クルーズ船での集団感染で死亡者3名。ハンタウイルスの限定的ヒト-ヒト感染が指摘されており、国際的な船舶関連感染症としてのリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは極地探検邪路Hondius（Argentina/Ushuaia発）での感染事例を主題としているが、発生地域リストに中国が含まれている。サマリー本文でも中国のHFRS不活化ワクチンの言及がある。Bluedot APIの地域検出にはArgentina が含まれるが、対象国リストに非該当のため verified_locations から除外。実際の船舶感染は複数国を航海しており、中国との関連（ワクチン言及・患者搬送可能性）から中国を含めた。ハンタウイルス感染の限定的ヒト-ヒト感染と3名の死亡により重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: พญาไท-เปาโล จับมือ Jaymart Group เปิดดีลสุขภาพเชิงรุกสร้าง ยกระดับการรับมือไข้เลือดออกเพื่อคนไทย | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Phayathai–Paolo join forces with Jaymart Group to launch a proactive health deal to boost dengue fever preparedness among Thai people
article.articleSummary: Phayathai–Paolo hospitals and Jaymart Group launch the 'Vaccination Helps Thai' campaign to boost dengue fever prevention in Thailand. Centers on the latest dengue vaccine Qdenga, covering four serotypes and approved for individuals aged 4 and older, including those with no prior dengue history; no immune screening required. Vaccination delivers over 80% protection against infection and reduces hospitalization by more than 90% when given in a two-dose schedule 3 months apart. The partnership combines medical vaccination expertise with Jaymart Insurance Broker’s benefits and risk management to enhance preventive care and financial protection. Perks include up to 30,000 THB dengue treatment coverage, Fitpoint and JPoint rewards, 0% installment options for up to four months, and cross-system point transfers to reduce medical costs. Campaign available now at all Phayathai–Paolo hospitals and runs through July 31, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: パヤタイ・パオロがJaymart Groupと提携し、積極的な健康ディールを開始してタイ人のデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱ワクチン接種キャンペーンの商業的発表であり、新規の感染症発生事象ではない。感染症の流行・異常事態の報告ではなく、予防プログラムの宣伝である。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防接種キャンペーンの商業的発表であり、感染症イベントの検知ではない。デング熱の流行状況報告、新規症例、異常な増加傾向などの記述がなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox cases in Thailand reach 48 after Songkran period
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 48 confirmed mpox cases as of May 3, with 43 due to Clade II and 5 to Clade Ib. The post-Songkran period overlaps with mpox’s 5–21 day incubation, so symptoms may appear now. Most patients are men aged 18–39, with sexual contact identified as the main transmission route. The outbreak is considered controllable, but monitoring continues and clusters with incomplete contact tracing may occur. Mpox spreads via close contact with infected skin lesions, bodily fluids, or prolonged exposure. Travellers and residents are advised to avoid close contact with symptomatic individuals, maintain hygiene, and reduce risky behaviour. Symptoms to watch include fever, fatigue, body aches, swollen lymph nodes, and rashes or blisters; those with travel or event exposure should seek medical care and provide history. Public health measures include surveillance, awareness campaigns, condom promotion, and prioritising vaccines for high-risk groups due to limited supply and cost.

triage.headline_ja: ソンクラーン期間後、タイのサル痘（Mpox）患者が48例に到達
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの確定患者48例が報告され、ソンクラーン期間後の流行拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染（性的接触経由）が確認されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目（異常性、重症度の可能性、流行しやすさ）に該当。タイは対象地域であり、国際的な公衆衛生関心事である。
triage.notes: Mpoxはクレード II（43例）とクレード Ib（5例）の両方が確認されている。主な伝播経路は性的接触で、18～39歳の男性が大部分。ソンクラーン期間後の潜伏期間（5～21日）と症例発生の時間的関連性が懸念される。公衆衛生当局は管理可能と評価しているが、継続的な監視が必要。ワクチン供給が限定的という制約がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận một ca tử vong do viêm não Nhật Bản
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One death due to Japanese encephalitis.
article.articleSummary: 1 death from Japanese encephalitis in Dong Son Ward, Thanh Hoa City, Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam. A girl born in 2012 presented with fever, headache, vomiting, and fatigue on 1 May, rapidly progressing to altered consciousness and increased muscle tone. Despite local treatment and transfer to Thanh Hoa Children’s Hospital, she died in the early hours of 6 May after ICU care. Lab confirmation by the Thanh Hoa Center for Disease Control and Prevention showed Japanese encephalitis via Mac-Elisa; the patient had not been vaccinated against JE. Epidemiologic investigation identified environmental and exposure risks near ponds, rice fields, drainage canals, livestock/poultry, and a nearby pig slaughter facility. Health authorities implemented control measures including contact surveillance, broad-area mosquito spraying within at least 200 m of the home, environmental cleanup, and vaccination status review. As of 7 May 2026, Thanh Hoa reports 3 JE cases, 1 fatal.

triage.headline_ja: 日本脳炎による1件の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重症度・異常性・国際拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準4項目該当。実検査確認済みの日本脳炎による死亡症例であり、ワクチン未接種患者の急速な進行と死亡、地域でのさらなる症例発生を示唆。
triage.notes: 実検査確認済みの日本脳炎死亡症例。患者は2012年生まれの女児でワクチン未接種。5月1日発症から5月6日死亡まで急速に進行。タイ・ハノイ・ザンビア・DRC等近接地域でも同時期流行の可能性があり、東南アジア地域の季節的流行パターンと一致。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Новые угрозы от клещей: в России обнаружили вирусы из далеких стран
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New threats from ticks: viruses from distant countries detected in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Beiji nairovirus, Mukwa virus, and Nuomin (Forest) virus have been detected in ticks in Russia's Northwest, according to Rospotrebnadzor. RNA sequencing of ticks by scientists at the Pasteur Institute of Epidemiology revealed traces of these three understudied pathogens in tick pools. None of the viruses have been isolated in laboratory culture, and their biological properties remain uncharacterized; risk assessments rely on foreign data. Similar pathogens have been found in blood samples from patients with fever-like infections in China and Japan. Russian strains are not identical to Asian counterparts; pathogenicity remains unknown and may shift with mutations, some potentially enhancing adaptation and others attenuating virulence. Eradication in nature is impossible. Preventive measures include wearing light, long clothing in forests, regular tick checks, and acaricidal treatments in parks and recreation areas.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい脅威：ダニから発見された遠い国のウイルス - ロシアで検出
triage.triage_reason: クリミア・コンゴ出血熱（CCHF）関連の複数の新規ナイロウイルスがロシアで検出された異常なシグナルですが、ヒト感染例が確認されていない段階であり、情報が不完全なため経過観察が適切です。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示す3か国（ロシア・日本・中国）のうち、対象国リストに含まれるのはChinaのみ。ロシアはWPRO地域外、日本も対象外。記事は東アジアとロシアの複数地域での関連ウイルス検出を報じていますが、ヒト感染例の詳細が記載されておらず、重症度や管理可能性の判断に不足があります。CCHF関連病原体としての国際的な関心は高まっていますが、現在の段階では確認されたケースが限定的であり、より多くの情報が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavírus: Mennyire veszélyes a hajón kitört járvány?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: How dangerous is the shipboard outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Andes strain hantavirus outbreak aboard MV Hondius, a Holland-flagged ship, off Ushuaia, Argentina, has infected at least seven people and caused three deaths. The vessel departed in early April for an Antarctic expedition; within weeks, cases emerged among passengers and crew. The Andes lineage is one of the deadliest hantaviruses, with case fatality around 40%, and unlike many hantaviruses, it can spread between people through close contact. Initial symptoms are influenza-like, followed by severe respiratory distress and potential heart failure. WHO cautions against global panic, noting slower, controllable transmission and that asymptomatic individuals are unlikely major spreaders. Investigations suggest infection began in Argentina, possibly involving a Dutch couple who became exposed while birdwatching near Ushuaia before boarding. There is no widely available hantavirus vaccine; vaccines for milder strains exist in China and Korea, with experimental DNA vaccines under development in the U.S.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス: 船上での流行はどの程度危険か?
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・死亡例あり、予想外の人-人感染、国際的な拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上該当（高い重症度・致死率40%・3名死亡、人-人感染可能性、国際支援可能性）。国際的に注目度の高いイベント。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には南米（アルゼンチン）、オランダ、米国、韓国が含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはChina（ハンタウイルスワクチン言及）のみ。イベント発生地はアルゼンチン（対象国外）だが、グローバルな公衆衛生脅威として評価。船舶での人-人感染確認例（Andes株：致死率40%）は極めて異例。WHOが注視中。ワクチン供給状況への言及あり。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: The latest on Brits aboard hantavirus-hit cruise and their arrival
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak linked to the MV Hondius: three people evacuated to the Netherlands for suspected infection, including one British national; UKHSA is coordinating with Cape Verde and Dutch authorities as the patients are monitored; two other individuals who had been on board returned to the UK independently; neither is symptomatic and both have been advised to self-isolate. Hantavirus is rodent-borne and spread mainly via contact with rodent urine, droppings, or saliva; person-to-person transmission is not typical. There is no specific treatment; care is supportive, with ventilation in severe cases and dialysis possible. Worldwide about 150,000 cases occur annually; the UK has very few. Infections concentrate in China, Russia, Scandinavia, and the US. Two main syndromes: HPS (lung-focused) and HFRS (kidney-focused). Early symptoms include coughing, shortness of breath, chest tightness; mortality among those with respiratory symptoms is around 38%. Fatality varies by virus: Saaremaa, Puumala <1%; Hantaan/Dobrava 5–15%; Seoul <1%.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染が報告されたクルーズ船の乗客の最新情報と到着状況
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染の疑い事例が複数国で検出され、国際的なクルーズ船での集団発生の可能性があるが、現時点では確定症例数が限定的（3名疑い）で、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低い。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUSA、オランダ、カーボベルデ、中国、ロシア、UKが列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はクルーズ船MV Hondius上のハンタウイルス感染事例である。サマリーではハンタウイルス感染が一般的に中国、ロシア、スカンジナビア、米国に集中していることが述べられており、検証可能な発生地は対象国リストではUSAとChinaのみである。クルーズ船は国際水域であり、患者は複数国への移動があるが、実際の感染源または発生地の特定は困難。ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類媒介で、ヒト-ヒト感染は典型的でない。疑い患者数が限定的で、死亡報告なし。IHR基準は2つ該当（異常/予想外＋国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準も1つ該当するが、確認症例の重症度や管理可能性に関する情報が不明のため、WATCHレベルの判定とした。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: I was infected with hantavirus... within weeks I was  hospitalised
article.articleSummary: Debbie Zipperian, from Clancy, Montana, contracted Sin Nombre hantavirus leading to Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) after inhaling rodent droppings; exposure likely under five minutes. She fell ill about a week later, was misdiagnosed as flu/pneumonia on multiple visits, and on a third visit was diagnosed; she was ventilated, nearly died twice, and spent seven days in an induced coma. She now has lasting spinal and neurological damage. In Montana, deer mice are the single hantavirus carrier. Separately, three deaths occurred on the MV Hondius cruise ship amid an Andes-strain hantavirus outbreak, with illness among several passengers; linked to a bird-watching excursion to a rubbish tip. Symptoms appear 1–8 weeks after exposure; early signs include fever, fatigue, pain; progression to fluid in lungs. Global context: about 150,000–200,000 cases per year, mostly in China; US ~890 cases (1993–2023); UK very few, first confirmed in 2012.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスに感染しました...数週間以内に入院しました
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染の個別症例報告であり、異常性・重症性は確認されるが、散発的な事例であり組織的流行の証拠がない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は主にモンタナ州の個別患者とコロンビアの客船での集団事例を扱っており、米国とコロンビアが主な発生地である。しかし対象国リストにはモンタナ州を含む米国とコロンビアが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはグローバルコンテキストで言及されているChina（1814991）のみを含める。個別症例報告であり、大規模流行やシステムの失敗の証拠がないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Cơn bão cytokine đẩy bé 4 tuổi mắc tay chân miệng vào nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cytokine storm drives a 4-year-old child with hand-foot-and-mouth disease into critical condition.
article.articleSummary: In Quảng Ninh, Vietnam, a 4-year-old boy with hand-foot-and-mouth disease (HFMD) due to enterovirus 71 developed a cytokine storm and rapid multi‑organ failure, placing him in critical condition. After 3 days of fever, he presented with fatigue, tachycardia (180–190 bpm), cyanotic skin and lips, cold extremities, and oral ulcers; diagnosed as severe HFMD (stage 4). He required sedation, endotracheal intubation, mechanical ventilation, cardiovascular support, IV immunoglobulin, and continuous renal replacement therapy to control the hyperinflammatory state and protect organs, especially the heart. Despite poor initial response, his condition improved after 2 days; by day 5 he was off dialysis and extubated. By the 14th day of treatment, he could sit, stand, eat, and walk, and was discharged with outpatient follow-up. The report notes a surge in severe HFMD cases in the month, with many positives for EV71, a virus linked to serious neurological and cardiac complications.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病患者の4歳児がサイトカインストーム発症により危機的状況に陥る
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム（対象国）でエンテロウイルス71による手足口病の重症患者が発生し、多臓器不全とサイトカインストームが記録されている。同月に同ウイルスの重症例が多発している報告があり、異常かつ重症度が高く、IHR基準2つ以上該当、かつWPRO基準複数該当のためピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは広西チワン族自治区（Quảng Ninh）での単一症例報告だが、同月のEV71重症例多発の傾向が示唆されている。EV71は神経学的・心臓学的合併症との関連が既知であり、公式サーベイランスデータ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 38 Filipinos cleared amid cruise ship hantavirus deaths
article.articleSummary: 38 Filipino crew of the MV Hondius have not contracted hantavirus amid a rare outbreak that killed three passengers. As of May 4, seven cases were identified: two laboratory-confirmed hantavirus infections and five suspected cases. WHO was notified May 2 of a cluster of severe respiratory illness aboard the vessel, which departed Ushuaia, Argentina on April 1 and crossed the South Atlantic with stops including Antarctica, South Georgia, Tristan da Cunha, Saint Helena and Ascension Island. The ship was reportedly near the Canary Islands and docked there with the 38 Filipino crew on board. Evacuations on May 6 saw three people—two crew and one other—taken off, with the vessel anchored off Cape Verde. The DMW coordinates with DFA, DOH and WHO; repatriation will await medical clearances and international protocols. Experts confirmed a rare hantavirus strain capable of human-to-human transmission.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船ハンタウイルス死亡事例の中、フィリピン人38人が陰性判定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ヒト-ヒト感染可能な稀なハンタウイルス株による国際的クラスタアウトブレイク。複数国への拡大・死亡例を含む。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに多数の国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの検証により、実際のイベント主体は国際クルーズ船上のアウトブレイクであり、フィリピン人乗組員に関連した報道。ハンタウイルスのヒト-ヒト感染事例は極めて稀であり、国際公衆衛生的に重要。米国・英国・アルゼンチン・スペイン・カーボベルデなどの位置情報も参考値として記載されているが、記事の主題はフィリピン乗組員の検査結果報告であるため、verified_locationsはフィリピンのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus concerns? 4 other emerging animal-to-human diseases that can be extremely deadly
article.articleSummary: Andes virus hantavirus on the MV Hondius in the Atlantic has killed three passengers; rodent droppings, urine or saliva transmit, with the Andes strain capable of person-to-person spread. Nipah virus is highly deadly (40–75%), spread via infected fruit bats or pigs or contaminated date palm sap; incubation 4–14 days; India has been a Nipah hotspot, with two nurses infected in 2025. Egyptian fruit bat hosts Nipah in Africa, the Middle East and the Mediterranean; exposure 2–21 days (most at 8–10); fever, headache and malaise progressing to vomiting; fatality 24–88%. Marburg outbreak in Ethiopia (Nov–Jan) left nine dead. Mpox (clade I) in the US totals 20 cases since Nov 2024, linked to travel from Central/Eastern Africa or Western Europe; flu-like illness followed by a rash; most recover in 2–4 weeks. Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever in Uganda this year; transmitted by Hyalomma ticks or contact with infected livestock; fatality 30–50%.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスの懸念？極度に致命的となりうる他の4つの新興動物由来人獣共通感染症
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク病原体（Marburg、Nipah、Mpox Clade I、CCHF、Hantavirus）の同時報告。Marburg（エチオピア、9死亡）とNipah（インド、2025年に医療従事者感染）の最近の発生事例、および国際的な地理的拡散（米国、アフリカ、インド）から、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の動物由来感染症（zoonotic diseases）を総括的に報道する教育的記事であるが、複数の高致死率病原体の最近の確認事例を含む。DRCは記事中で言及されていないが、Mpox Clade Iは中央・東アフリカからの渡航リンクで報告されており、DRCが主要発生地の可能性がある。ただし記事サマリーに明示的な言及がないため、DRCは除外検討の対象。最終的には記事が具体的に言及するIndia（Nipah）のみverified_locationsに含める。エチオピアはMarburg発生（11月～1月、9死亡）を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Molnupiravir: Tratamento com até 90% de resposta clínica muda cenário da peritonite infecciosa felina no Brasil - Digivets
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Molnupiravir: Treatment with Up to 90% Clinical Response Changes the Landscape of Feline Infectious Peritonitis in Brazil - Digivets
article.articleSummary: Feline infectious peritonitis (FIP) in Brazil now has a potentially transformative antiviral: molnupiravir, prepared as a veterinary product in Brazil in multiple dosage forms (biscuits, paste, oil suspension) with weight-based dosing and an approximately 84-day therapy course. Remission rates reach 80-90% in non-neurological FIP, similar to imported GS-441524, supported by a 2023 Journal of Veterinary Internal Medicine study showing 14 of 18 cats achieving stable remission with early fever and appetite improvement. FIP results from a mutation of feline enteric coronavirus (FCoV) enabling replication in macrophages, causing effusive (wet) or dry forms. Diagnosis combines history, laboratory tests, imaging, and detection of viral RNA by RT-PCR in effusions or tissues with immunohistochemistry to increase specificity. High-risk cats include young (<3 years), elderly, FIV/FeLV positives, and certain predisposed breeds. Emphasis is on early antiviral therapy, with careful hematologic monitoring due to potential reversible blood changes.

triage.headline_ja: モルヌピラビル：猫伝染性腹膜炎の臨床反応率90%までの治療がブラジルの状況を変える - Digivets

triage.notes: 本件は動物感染症（猫伝染性腹膜炎FIP）に関する獣医学的治療開発の報道であり、ヒト感染症ではない。IHR監視対象外。感染症危機管理・バイオセキュリティの観点からはシグナルとして識別しない。

article.articleHeadline: África Ocidental registra novos riscos de gripe aviária em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Africa records new avian influenza risks in 2026.
article.articleSummary: In April 2026, Ivory Coast confirmed a new focus of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A(H5N1) in the Koun-Fao region near the Ghana border, detected at a commercial farm and resulting in about 95,000 birds lost. The outbreak was reported to the World Organisation for Animal Health (OMSA) and marks the disease’s return to Ivory Coast after nearly a decade, with major prior outbreaks in 2015–2016. Proximity to borders raises concerns about informal cross-border bird movement, regional trade, and migratory routes. Meanwhile, Nigeria continues to experience avian influenza circulation with multiple strains, including H5N1 (present since 2006), as well as H5N8, H5N6, and where H9N2 (low pathogenicity) circulates in live bird markets. Co-circulation of diverse subtypes heightens risks of viral evolution and complicates control. Emphasis remains on biosafety, farm biosecurity, market hygiene, and continuous epidemiological monitoring to mitigate health and economic impacts on poultry production and trade.

triage.headline_ja: 西アフリカが2026年の高病原性鳥インフルエンザの新たなリスクを記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（異常性、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。動物感染症であるが人獣共通感染病（H5N1は人感染リスク）として国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: コートジボワールが記事の主題だが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ガーナは国境隣接地域で懸念されており、対象国リストに含まれるため収録。ナイジェリアも記事に含まれるが対象国リストに含まれていない。H5N1の人感染リスク、多数亜型の共循環、地域的流行の継続性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Aeróstach KLM san ospidéal san Ísiltír le comharthaí hantavíris
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KLM flight attendant in hospital in the Netherlands with hantavirus symptoms.
article.articleSummary: A KLM flight attendant in Amsterdam is hospitalised with hantavirus-like symptoms after contact with a woman who died of hantavirus in Johannesburg. Health authorities are tracing cases linked to the MV Hondius cruise off Cape Verde, with eight infections on board and three deaths. The Dutch–German couple who contracted the virus on board died (the wife after disembarking in Santa Helena; the husband on board on April 11). About 40 passengers disembarked in Santa Helena during the voyage. The Argentine couple, who later died, had travelled through Chile, Uruguay and Argentina, leaving Argentina on November 27 and boarding Hondius on April 1 after a return to Argentina on March 27. Argentina plans flea tests in Ushuaia. Yesterday, three passengers were hospitalised in the Netherlands and Germany; a third patient’s plane departed this morning after life-support delays, and the German passenger’s body remains aboard. Experts say a Asian Indian hantavirus strain is involved, with rare human-to-human transmission via close contact.

article.articleHeadline: कालांवाली: सफाई कर्मचारी हड़ताल का सातवां दिन; कूड़े के ढेर से शहर बेहाल, बीमारियों का मंडराया खतरा - Lalluram Kalanwali Sanitation Workers Strike: Garbage Piles Up in City
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kalanwali: Seventh day of sanitation workers' strike; city reeling from garbage heaps, looming threat of diseases.
article.articleSummary: Kalanwali city in Sirsa district, on 7 May 2026, enters the seventh day of a sanitation workers' strike, leaving municipal cleanliness in disarray. Garbage piles line the main markets, lanes, and public spaces as dustbins fill and no space remains to dump new waste. Filth and putrefaction bring pervasive odors, with clogged drains and roaming animals heightening disease risk. With rising temperatures, mosquitoes and flies have surged, fueling fears of dengue and malaria among residents. Workers demand higher wages, permanent appointments, and safety gear, saying promises have been false and they have resorted to industrial action. Councillor Mangat Nagar urges sympathetic consideration and for the administration to arrange alternative measures while negotiations proceed. Civil society and business groups warn of protests if sanitation is not restored soon; the public awaits resolution.

triage.headline_ja: カーラーンワーリー：清掃労働者ストの7日目、ゴミの山が街を苦しめ、病気の脅威が迫る

triage.notes: 記事はインドのハリヤーナ州カーラーンワーリーにおける清掃労働者ストライキと衛生危機を報じており、デング熱とマラリアのリスク増加が言及されているが、確認された症例報告や患者数の増加は記載されていない。ベクター媒介感染症の潜在的リスク増加を指摘しているため、継続的な経過観察が推奨される。症例確認時はPICKUPへの昇格が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus, hostess di volo ricoverata in Olanda: contatti con la donna morta a Johannesburg. La nave da crociera in viaggio verso le Canarie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus, flight attendant hospitalized in the Netherlands: contacts with the woman who died in Johannesburg. The cruise ship en route to the Canary Islands.
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, a flight attendant in the Netherlands is hospitalized with hantavirus linked to a woman who died in Johannesburg, amid concern over the Andean strain. The cruise ship MV Hondius, en route to the Canary Islands, is central to the investigation as passengers who disembarked and returned home are identified as the outbreak’s origin. Experts fear a potential chain of transmission, though hantavirus transmission between humans is described as rare. There is no current alarm for a Covid-like pandemic, but caution is high among virologists. The piece contrasts hantavirus with the early-2020 Wuhan Covid outbreak, noting that hantavirus infections could be more aggressive and lethal. Epidemiological tracing of imported/exported cases continues, leveraging the ship as a focal point for monitoring and containment efforts.

article.articleHeadline: Kas ir hantavīruss, kas apsēdis kruīza kuģi Atlantijas okeānā?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is hantavirus, which has seized a cruise ship in the Atlantic Ocean?
article.articleSummary: Confirmed illnesses linked to the Andes hantavirus variant aboard an Atlantic cruise ship. Infected include a Dutch citizen who has died; a British passenger in intensive care in Johannesburg; and a Swiss patient treated in Zurich. Others are considered possibly infected: a British passenger, a Dutch crew member, and a German national. In the U.S., authorities in Arizona and Georgia monitor three passengers who left the cruise; no symptoms yet. Andes hantavirus is a rodent-borne virus usually spread by inhaling dust with rodent urine or feces, but the Andes variant can rarely transmit between people through very close, prolonged contact. The virus is most common in Argentina and Chile. On the ship, passengers are isolated in cabins; emphasis on handwashing, contact tracing, and isolation of cases. Wider public risk appears low; no evidence of spread off the ship. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, and muscle pains; incubation can be weeks. CFR 20-40%. No specific treatment or widely available vaccine; some vaccines are used in China and South Korea against local strains.

triage.headline_ja: 大西洋の客船で発生したハンタウイルス感染とは何か？
triage.triage_reason: Andes hantavirus variant による国際的な集団発生事例。死亡者が出ており致命率が高く(20-40%)、人間から人間への感染の可能性があることが懸念される。複数国に患者が散在し国際的な拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに多数の国が含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際の患者発生が確認されている対象国は China のみ（ワクチン使用国として言及）。オランダ、イギリス、スイス、ドイツ、アメリカなどにも患者がいるが、評価対象国リストに該当しない。南アフリカ（ヨハネスブルク）も患者がいるが対象国外。Andes hantavirus は人間から人間への伝播が稀だが可能との記述は重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Yinson renovates Dixcove hospital wards to support malaria fight
article.articleSummary: Yinson Ghana renovated the male and female wards of Nana Hema Dekyi Government Hospital in Dixcove, Ahanta West Municipality, to strengthen malaria management and general patient care ahead of World Malaria Day 2026. The upgrade follows a 2025 World Malaria Day effort in Agona that supplied malaria-management equipment. To promote community health, Yinson organized a five-kilometre marathon for local Junior High students, with five top participants receiving tablets. Dr. Ana Asampong Brobbey, Medical Director, urged intensified malaria prevention through environmental sanitation and sustained use of insecticide-treated nets, stressing ongoing community engagement. Benjamin Acquah, Laboratory Manager, stressed that treatment requires laboratory confirmation; fever, headache and weakness may appear 7–14 days after infection, and yellowish urine can indicate complications. Complete anti-malarial courses, follow-up testing, and safe handling of nets and insecticide sprays were also emphasized. Yinson underscored its long-term investment in health and education in Ghana.
